test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Town L lies to the west of Town M. Town D lies to the northeast of Town L. Town A lies to the west of Town D. Town R lies to the east of Town D. What is the position of Town R with respect to Town L?
solution: Given: Town L lies to the west of Town M. Town D lies to the northeast of Town L. Town A lies to the west of Town D. Town R lies to the east of Town D.
